semantics.function: When sel=0 out=a; when sel=1 out=b.
semantics.timing: Combinational selection with no added latency; original specifies a multiplexer and no clock port.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization specified; output follows selected input.

numeric.interpretation: Bit-vector selection without arithmetic or signed conversion.

verification.oracle: Original problem selection rules, checked with explicit if/else expected values for known sel.
verification.sampling: Check after a 1 ns combinational settling interval following stimulus changes.
verification.cases: Both select values, all-zero/all-one, alternating patterns, each bit walking one and walking zero, random vectors, selected X/Z data propagation.
verification.failure: Case inequality mismatch invokes fatal; bounded timeout and PASS after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for sel=X or sel=Z is unspecified; use standard Verilog conditional merge semantics without asserting a required oracle for those select values.
